text: Your receptionist is helping a patient. The phone rings later the practice closes. Someone else calls what happens to those inquiries. Watch how a call can reach a booking while your team stays in control. Flow audit builds AI phone agents that support your team through agreed workflows. You agree when calls are forwarded, which appointments the agent can handle and when a person needs to step in. Here's a recorded demo. A new patient asks for a checkup. Hi, I just wanted to ring in and book an appointment. The agent offers available times. The first available appointment this afternoon is at 2.30 or 3 in the afternoon or 3.30. Which one works for you? Can we do 3 o'clock? The caller chooses 3 o'clock and here is the booking in Google Calendar. Your new patient checkup appointment is booked for Wednesday, the 7th of October at 3 in the afternoon. That's the workflow to assess. Give routine inquiries a clear next step during busy periods and after hours without pulling your team away from the patient in front of them. Start with your own call records, which inquiries need a reply and which can your team already handle. Before set up, we check your scheduling, forwarding and patient data requirements. Clinical judgment stays with your team. You agree scope and investment. Agreement and initial payment start configuration followed by testing with your team. Activation follows your approval. Book a 15-minute demo and fit assessment. Bring the person who approves the purchase. We'll look at your call workflows and decide whether there's a useful fit.
